author: Krono II
title: Paper Revision Baseline: A2C on Single-Step Arch
abstract: This experiment is required for my paper revision. I am running the A2C-style algorithm (default training_step) on Zephyr I's single-step architecture to establish my own baseline, as per reviewer feedback. This result will be used for comparison against my PPO implementation on the same architecture.
